adaptations.withheld: sacred or restricted dance: no teaching adaptations

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Arms are often used for balance or to support other performers; the child at the top holds arms open.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Two rows for the initial dance; dense, circular human tower for the figures.
movement_profile.partnering: High level of physical contact and trust required for building human towers.

signature_moves.description: Building a multi-level human structure to form a symbolic shape.
signature_moves.name: Tower construction

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Not described in sources, but requires professional training to avoid injury.

music_profile.sound_description: The music is defined by the piercing, high-pitched, and loud sound of the dolçaina, supported by the steady, rhythmic beat of the tabalet drum.

basic_steps: Crowning of the tower by the child
teaching.formation: Two rows for the initial dance, transitioning into a dense circular base for the tower.
teaching.level_notes: Requires significant physical strength, balance, and coordination; training is conducted under a master.
teaching.rhythm: Traditional, rhythmic pulse set by the tabalet and dolçaina.
